name: Muse Code

form_factor.comment: Terminal-native coding agent for macOS and Linux. Install with the official dev.meta.ai shell installer.

latest_major_update.comment: Muse Spark 1.3 reached Muse Code in September 2026 with stronger long-horizon coding, better context and prior-result tracking, fewer unnecessary turns, and cleaner output.

pricing.value: Meta Model API usage billing; API key required
pricing.comment: Muse Code authenticates against Meta's developer API with a Meta API key.

some_free_usage.comment: Free included usage was not established from the public documentation reviewed.

no_account_required.comment: A Meta developer credential is required for the Meta provider.

can_use_other_subscriptions.comment: The native CLI uses Meta credentials rather than another vendor subscription.

rules.comment: The CLI loads workspace and personal rules when the workspace is trusted; local verification showed AGENTS.md compatibility.

skills.comment: Ships with default skills including /plan and /grill, and exposes skill management commands.

hooks.comment: No public lifecycle-hook contract was established from the documentation reviewed.

mcp_servers.comment: MCP server configuration was not established from the public documentation reviewed.

custom_commands.comment: Built-in slash skills are documented; a user-defined command directory was not established.

subagents.comment: Persistent background agents and parallel repository-scale work are core Muse Code capabilities.

monitor.comment: Background agents remain active during long-running work, but a separate generic monitor/watch command was not established.

transcripts.comment: Sessions and event logs are persisted locally by default; --no-session-log disables persistence for a run.

transcript_location.value: Local session/event logs; exact path undocumented
transcript_location.comment: Sessions and event logs are persisted locally by default; --no-session-log disables persistence for a run.

model_selection.comment: The CLI accepts --model; Muse Spark 1.2 is the current default tested locally.

approval_mode.comment: The CLI exposes untrusted, on-request, never, and --yolo approval controls.

sandbox_mode.comment: The CLI has sandbox controls and a --yolo escape hatch for trusted local work.

resume.comment: muse resume supports the workspace picker, --last, or an explicit session UUID.

continue.comment: muse resume --last continues the most recent workspace session without an ID.

non_interactive.comment: muse exec runs one prompt non-interactively.

output_format.comment: muse exec --json emits machine-readable JSONL events.

statusline.comment: A user-configurable status line was not established from the public documentation reviewed.

telemetry.comment: User-configurable telemetry controls were not established from the public documentation reviewed.

keyboard_shortcuts.comment: Custom keybindings were not established from the public documentation reviewed.

theme_customization.comment: Theme customization was not established from the public documentation reviewed.

auto_save.comment: Session event logs are append-only and restart-safe, but a separate file auto-save setting was not established.

debugging_output.comment: The CLI exposes trace and local event-log inspection commands.

context_window.comment: Muse Spark 1.2 is the coding-focused model used by Muse Code; context details are model/API dependent.

code_formatting.comment: Built-in formatter integration was not established from the public documentation reviewed.

git_integration.comment: The CLI supports Git worktree session modes and isolated subagent worktrees.

performance_mode.comment: Reasoning effort is configurable from minimal through ultra.

ui_customization.comment: TUI layout customization was not established from the public documentation reviewed.

hosted_agent.comment: Muse Code is a local terminal agent; the model API is hosted separately.

custom_model_provider.comment: The CLI is Meta-provider-first but exposes a base URL override for compatible gateways.

notes: Muse Code is Meta's terminal coding agent powered by Muse Spark 1.2. Local verification on this Mac used Muse Code 0.1.0-R708.1 and returned a successful headless response.
